title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, 4.8 Lagrange Multipliers: Use the method of Lagrange multipliers to solve optimization problems with one constraint.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, 4.8 Lagrange Multipliers: Use the method of Lagrange multipliers to solve optimization problems with one constraint.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 3, section "4.8 Lagrange Multipliers", prints these objectives: "Use the method of Lagrange multipliers to solve optimization problems with one constraint." "Use the method of Lagrange multipliers to solve optimization problems with two constraints.". The section text says: "Solving optimization problems for functions of two or more variables can be similar to solving such problems in single-variable calculus. However, techniques for dealing with multiple variables allow us to solve more varied optimization problems for which we need to deal with additional conditions or constraints. In this section, we examine one of the more common and useful methods for solving optimization problems with constraints." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
